data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Yehoron is derived from the Hebrew words yah (God) and horon (gracious). The name signifies that God is gracious and merciful. In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but it is present in the list of the descendants of Aaron and Eleazar (Exodus 6:21). The name Yehoron carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Yehoron usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
